s0401.literal: On renchen day the crown prince said: "Minister of Education Liu Kui, taking relay transport to visit his family in Jiangnan, greatly disturbed the common people, and has not returned for two years.
s0401.idiomatic: On renchen day the crown prince said, "Minister of Education Liu Kui, taking relay transport to visit his family in Jiangnan, greatly disturbed the common people, and has not returned for two years.

s0403.literal: On gengzi day Tanzhou was placed under the empress's control.
s0403.idiomatic: On gengzi day Tanzhou was placed under the empress's control.

s0404.literal: The people of Shangdu were famished; an order directed Minister of Justice Saduddin to release ten thousand shi of grain, lowering the price to sell it for relief.
s0404.idiomatic: The people of Shangdu were famished; an order directed Minister of Justice Saduddin to release 10,000 shi of grain, lowering the price to sell it for relief.

s0405.literal: On renyin day an edict directed that for officials redundantly established in all offices, monthly salaries were not to be given.
s0405.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict directed that for officials redundantly established in all offices, monthly salaries were not to be given.

s0406.literal: An edict addressed Sanbaonu and others: "Last year the central secretariat memorialized that officials in all offices should follow the Dade tenth-year fixed establishment, and redundant ones be eliminated.
s0406.idiomatic: An edict addressed Sanbaonu and others, "Last year the central secretariat memorialized that officials in all offices should follow the Dade tenth-year fixed establishment, and redundant ones be eliminated.

s0407.literal: Now we hear the ranks remain redundantly as before, with some taking up their posts without reporting it.
s0407.idiomatic: Now we hear the ranks remain redundantly as before, with some taking up their posts without reporting it.

s0408.literal: An imperial order directed: those who without memorializing arbitrarily appoint others to posts, and those who take up posts — all are to be arrested; I shall not lightly release them."
s0408.idiomatic: An imperial order directed: those who without memorializing arbitrarily appoint others to posts, and those who take up posts — all are to be arrested; I shall not lightly release them."

s0409.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiachen new moon: Venus crossed the meridian.
s0409.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, jiachen new moon: Venus crossed the meridian.

s0410.literal: On bingwu day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.
s0410.idiomatic: On bingwu day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.

s0411.literal: Sanbaonu and Minister of Education Tian Zhongliang and others said: "Formerly by imperial order we were to carry out Southern Suburb paired offerings and attendant sacrifices, Northern Suburb square mound, and sunrise and sunset moon rites.
s0411.idiomatic: Sanbaonu and Minister of Education Tian Zhongliang and others said, "Formerly by imperial order we were to carry out Southern Suburb paired offerings and attendant sacrifices, Northern Suburb square mound, and sunrise and sunset moon rites.

s0412.literal: Your subjects discuss — to sacrifice at the Northern Suburb, the Southern Suburb must come first.
s0412.idiomatic: Your subjects discuss — to sacrifice at the Northern Suburb, the Southern Suburb must come first.

s0413.literal: This year's winter solstice, sacrifice at the Round Mound, honoring Taizu Emperor as paired recipient; next year's summer solstice, sacrifice at the Square Mound, honoring Shizu Emperor as paired recipient; spring and autumn sunrise and sunset moon — truly conforming to the sacrificial canon."
s0413.idiomatic: This year's winter solstice, sacrifice at the Round Mound, honoring Taizu Emperor as paired recipient; next year's summer solstice, sacrifice at the Square Mound, honoring Shizu Emperor as paired recipient; spring and autumn sunrise and sunset moon — truly conforming to the sacrificial canon."

s0414.literal: " An imperial order: "The ritual implements to be used — order the relevant offices to prepare them quickly.
s0414.idiomatic: An imperial order: "The ritual implements to be used — order the relevant offices to prepare them quickly.

s0415.literal: " They further said: "In ancestral temple sacrifices, earthenware vessels are used; we beg they be replaced with silver.
s0415.idiomatic: They further said, "In ancestral temple sacrifices, earthenware vessels are used; we beg they be replaced with silver.

s0417.literal: On wushen day the Emperor led the crown prince, princes, and officials to attend at Xingsheng Palace, presenting the empress dowager's honorific seal and regalia reading: Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan.
s0417.idiomatic: On wushen day the Emperor led the crown prince, princes, and officials to attend at Xingsheng Palace, presenting the empress dowager's honorific seal and regalia reading: Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan.

s0418.literal: On gengxu day grateful thanks were offered at the imperial ancestral temple.
s0418.idiomatic: On gengxu day grateful thanks were offered at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0419.literal: On guichou day Mars transgressed Kang.
s0419.idiomatic: On guichou day Mars transgressed Kang.

s0420.literal: On jiayin day an edict addressed within and without: "Common households registering under princes, imperial consorts, and noble close officials to evade corvée and levies — this has already been forbidden.
s0420.idiomatic: On jiayin day an edict addressed within and without, "Common households registering under princes, imperial consorts, and noble close officials to evade corvée and levies — this has already been forbidden.

s0421.literal: From now on violators shall be made to serve military relay and build the Central Capital.
s0421.idiomatic: From now on violators shall be made to serve military relay and build the Central Capital.

s0422.literal: Prefecture and county officials who fail to detect them shall be dismissed.
s0422.idiomatic: Prefecture and county officials who fail to detect them shall be dismissed.

s0423.literal: " Monk Yilianzhen Qilesi was enfeoffed Duke of Wen State and granted a gold seal.
s0423.idiomatic: Monk Yilianzhen Qilesi was enfeoffed Duke of Wen State and granted a gold seal.

s0424.literal: Censorate officials said: "Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat pingzhang Umar sent men following envoy Niza Mading to leave the route and rush relay transport, taking a corrupt official from Shaoxing prison and releasing him.
s0424.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat pingzhang Umar sent men following envoy Niza Mading to leave the route and rush relay transport, taking a corrupt official from Shaoxing prison and releasing him.

s0425.literal: " An edict directed censorate officials to dispatch officers to investigate, without showing partiality.
s0425.idiomatic: An edict directed censorate officials to dispatch officers to investigate, without showing partiality.

s0426.literal: Shandong, Xu, and Pi and other places suffered flood and drought; more than four thousand ingots of notes confiscated by the censorate were used for relief.
s0426.idiomatic: Shandong, Xu, and Pi and other places suffered flood and drought; more than 4,000 ingots of notes confiscated by the censorate were used for relief.

s0427.literal: On dingsi day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "The Xuanzheng Bureau's daily allowances are increasing; though reserves are broad, they still cannot supply them — increases and reductions should be apportioned.
s0427.idiomatic: On dingsi day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "The Xuanzheng Bureau's daily allowances are increasing; though reserves are broad, they still cannot supply them — increases and reductions should be apportioned.

s0428.literal: " The Emperor said: "Recently I observed the inner palace's food and drink is no different from mine — is there such a principle?
s0428.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Recently I observed the inner palace's food and drink is no different from mine — is there such a principle?

s0429.literal: Order Bedashah together with Xuanzheng Bureau officials to verify and reduce them proportionally.
s0429.idiomatic: Order Bedashah together with Xuanzheng Bureau officials to verify and reduce them proportionally.

s0430.literal: " On gengshen day an edict: "Ministry of Revenue affairs are heavy and numerous; those with talent, insight, and clear judgement in all offices shall all be selected and appointed by the Ministry of Revenue; the privy council, censorate, and all other offices must not memorialize for appointment without authorization — violators punished by law.
s0430.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict: "Ministry of Revenue affairs are heavy and numerous; those with talent, insight, and clear judgement in all offices shall all be selected and appointed by the Ministry of Revenue; the privy council, censorate, and all other offices must not memorialize for appointment without authorization — violators punished by law.

s0431.literal: If through private connections they request appointments, they are dismissed without reinstatement.
s0431.idiomatic: If through private connections they request appointments, they are dismissed without reinstatement.

s0432.literal: " On xinyou day because the empress dowager received an honorific title, an amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
s0432.idiomatic: On xinyou day because the empress dowager received an honorific title, an amnesty was granted throughout the realm.

s0433.literal: Dadu, Shangdu, and Zhongdu compared with other commanderies — supplies are burdensome and harassing; the autumn tax of Zhidawu third year is remitted.
s0433.idiomatic: Dadu, Shangdu, and Zhongdu compared with other commanderies — supplies are burdensome and harassing; the autumn tax of Zhidawu third year is remitted.

s0434.literal: All other places — this year's disaster-affected households, once verified on inspection, likewise receive remission as above.
s0434.idiomatic: All other places — this year's disaster-affected households, once verified on inspection, likewise receive remission as above.

s0435.literal: Urgent corvées within and without are to be halted from the set date.
s0435.idiomatic: Urgent corvées within and without are to be halted from the set date.

s0436.literal: Levies and tax assignments owed by commoners before Zhidawu second year are all remitted.
s0436.idiomatic: Levies and tax assignments owed by commoners before Zhidawu second year are all remitted.

s0437.literal: Kuokuochu's remaining partisans not yet discovered — their crimes are all pardoned.
s0437.idiomatic: Kuokuochu's remaining partisans not yet discovered — their crimes are all pardoned.

s0438.literal: Official and commoner fields and lands everywhere have their respective ownerships; others must not present claims.
s0438.idiomatic: Official and commoner fields and lands everywhere have their respective ownerships; others must not present claims.

s0439.literal: Sanbaonu said Ministry and provincial officials are unwilling to attend diligently; an edict: "From now gather at dawn and disperse at dusk; if slack or lax, need not report it — punish conveniently on the spot.
s0439.idiomatic: Sanbaonu said Ministry and provincial officials are unwilling to attend diligently; an edict: "From now gather at dawn and disperse at dusk; if slack or lax, need not report it — punish conveniently on the spot.

s0440.literal: Those who after arrival take one or two months' leave citing illness shall be beaten, dismissed, and not reinstated.
s0440.idiomatic: Those who after arrival take one or two months' leave citing illness shall be beaten, dismissed, and not reinstated.

s0441.literal: " They further said: "When the late chancellor Heluhuosi was in office, deliberation office left and right section case officers and Six Ministries officials daily provided one meal — otherwise they returned hungry, delaying public business; now they have no means of support; we beg each be granted two hundred ingots of notes, invested in guiyun capital from which interest is drawn for food.
s0441.idiomatic: They further said, "When the late chancellor Heluhuosi was in office, deliberation office left and right section case officers and Six Ministries officials daily provided one meal — otherwise they returned hungry, delaying public business; now they have no means of support; we beg each be granted 200 ingots of notes, invested in guiyun capital from which interest is drawn for food.

s0443.literal: On dingmao day Prince Mubala's son Maiju Han was enfeoffed Prince of Yan.
s0443.idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince Mubala's son Maiju Han was enfeoffed Prince of Yan.

s0444.literal: On renshen day Prince of Jin Yesun Temuer said: "Shizu granted me the land, gold and silver, and copper smelters that Zhang Temuer presented; later Chengzong confiscated lands and households occupied by princes, with levies paid to county officials — we beg they be returned.
s0444.idiomatic: On renshen day Prince of Jin Yesun Temuer said, "Shizu granted me the land, gold and silver, and copper smelters that Zhang Temuer presented; later Chengzong confiscated lands and households occupied by princes, with levies paid to county officials — we beg they be returned.

s0445.literal: " Approved; two thousand ingots of notes were also granted to relieve his following's poor.
s0445.idiomatic: Approved; 2,000 ingots of notes were also granted to relieve his following's poor.

s0446.literal: Jiang-Zhe provincial officials said: "Formerly Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan's sea-transport grain was four hundred to five hundred thousand up to one million one hundred thousand per year; then ships were many and grain few, so hire costs were evenly fair.
s0446.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe provincial officials said, "Formerly Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan's sea-transport grain was 400,000 to 500,000 up to 1,100,000 per year; then ships were many and grain few, so hire costs were evenly fair.

s0447.literal: In recent years levies arose at random; transport households are impoverished and exhausted, and some have fled.
s0447.idiomatic: In recent years levies arose at random; transport households are impoverished and exhausted, and some have fled.

s0448.literal: This year three million are to be transported; transport ships are insufficient; men were sent to Zhedong, Fujian, and other places to hire — the people were alarmed.
s0448.idiomatic: This year 3 million are to be transported; transport ships are insufficient; men were sent to Zhedong, Fujian, and other places to hire — the people were alarmed.

s0449.literal: This province's left vice director Shabuding said his younger brother Hebashi, Mahemu Dande, the Ganpu Yang clan, and others all have boats and deeply understand transport affairs; we beg they be made officials of the Sea Route Grain Transport Chief Ten-Thousand Households Office, each transport official grain by their own means; ten-thousand and thousand household posts to be inherited like military officers, treat transport households leniently, increase hire payments — then there may be results.
s0449.idiomatic: This province's left vice director Shabuding said his younger brother Hebashi, Mahemu Dande, the Ganpu Yang clan, and others all have boats and deeply understand transport affairs; we beg they be made officials of the Sea Route Grain Transport Chief Ten-Thousand Households Office, each transport official grain by their own means; ten-thousand and thousand household posts to be inherited like military officers, treat transport households leniently, increase hire payments — then there may be results.

s0450.literal: " The Ministry of Revenue reported; it was requested that Mahemu Dande be remotely appointed right vice director, overseer of overseas territories pacification commissioner, commander-in-chief, and director of the Sea Route Chief Transport Ten-Thousand Households Office; ten thousand-household posts established, each with one darughachi, three wanhu, two vice wanhu, and four centurions — approved.
s0450.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue reported; it was requested that Mahemu Dande be remotely appointed right vice director, overseer of overseas territories pacification commissioner, commander-in-chief, and director of the Sea Route Chief Transport Ten-Thousand Households Office; ten-thousand household posts established, each with one darughachi, three wanhu, two vice wanhu, and four centurions — approved.

s0451.literal: Yunnan branch secretariat censor-in-chief Tegudai'er left his post without authorization to come to the capital; an imperial order questioned him; by the empress dowager's order he was pardoned and ordered back to his post.
s0451.idiomatic: Yunnan branch secretariat censor-in-chief Tegudai'er left his post without authorization to come to the capital; an imperial order questioned him; by the empress dowager's order he was pardoned and ordered back to his post.

s0452.literal: Censor-in-chief Tiegudai'er was made Shaanxi Branch Censorate chief censor; an edict addressed Shaanxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Gansu.
s0452.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Tiegudai'er was made Shaanxi Branch Censorate chief censor; an edict addressed Shaanxi, Sichuan, Yunnan, and Gansu.

s0453.literal: An edict addressed the Chief Agriculture Commission to encourage farming and sericulture.
s0453.idiomatic: An edict addressed the Chief Agriculture Commission to encourage farming and sericulture.

s0454.literal: Eleventh month, jiaxu new moon: Venus transgressed Kang.
s0454.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiaxu new moon: Venus transgressed Kang.

s0455.literal: On wuyin day Jining, Dongping, and other routes suffered famine; households previously relieved are exempt from this year's levies; those not yet relieved have half reduced proportionally.
s0455.idiomatic: On wuyin day Jining, Dongping, and other routes suffered famine; households previously relieved are exempt from this year's levies; those not yet relieved have half reduced proportionally.

s0456.literal: An edict addressed Li Ri: memorials to the Ministry of Revenue — all censorate appointment matters, do not involve them hereafter.
s0456.idiomatic: An edict addressed Li Ri: memorials to the Ministry of Revenue — all censorate appointment matters, do not involve them hereafter.

s0457.literal: On gengchen day Henan suffered flooding; the dead were given coffins; those whose houses were washed away were given notes; grain relief for two months by registered mouths verified; this year's rent and levies remitted; overdue collections halted.
s0457.idiomatic: On gengchen day Henan suffered flooding; the dead were given coffins; those whose houses were washed away were given notes; grain relief for two months by registered mouths verified; this year's rent and levies remitted; overdue collections halted.

s0458.literal: On xinsi day Ministry of Revenue officials said: "This year one million ingots of Zhidawu notes have already been printed; we beg twenty thousand more be printed, and copper cash circulate together, to supply the guards and falconry office in urgent need.
s0458.idiomatic: On xinsi day Ministry of Revenue officials said, "This year 1 million ingots of Zhidawu notes have already been printed; we beg 20,000 more be printed, and copper cash circulate together, to supply the guards and falconry office in urgent need.

s0459.literal: " They further said: "Shangdu and Zhongdu silver smelting intendant Bedulusi last year submitted four thousand two hundred fifty taels of silver; this autumn submitted three thousand five hundred more, and says a new mine was found — silver production should increase; we beg he be promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Discussion.
s0459.idiomatic: They further said, "Shangdu and Zhongdu silver smelting intendant Bedulusi last year submitted 4,250 taels of silver; this autumn submitted 3,500 more, and says a new mine was found — silver production should increase; we beg he be promoted to Grand Master for Glorious Discussion.

s0461.literal: Tuohuotuo was promoted to grand preceptor and recorder of military and state affairs, enfeoffed Duke of Yi State.
s0461.idiomatic: Tuohuotuo was promoted to grand preceptor and recorder of military and state affairs, enfeoffed Duke of Yi State.

s0462.literal: On renwu day the Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple Guiyun overall administration bureau was changed to Longxi Bureau, rank 2b.
s0462.idiomatic: On renwu day the Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple Guiyun overall administration bureau was changed to Longxi Bureau, rank 2b.

s0463.literal: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Bi.
s0463.idiomatic: On dinghai day the moon encroached upon Bi.

s0464.literal: On wuzi day the crown prince's consort Qielian household overall administration bureau was changed to Palace Inner Service.
s0464.idiomatic: On wuzi day the crown prince's consort Qielian household overall administration bureau was changed to Palace Inner Service.

s0465.literal: Because Yidu, Ninghai, and other places suffered famine several years running, falconry hunting was suspended; other hunting grounds also ordered restricted, awaiting autumn harvest.
s0465.idiomatic: Because Yidu, Ninghai, and other places suffered famine several years running, falconry hunting was suspended; other hunting grounds also ordered restricted, awaiting autumn harvest.

s0466.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Yunnan Lin'an, Dali, and other pacification commissions, Lijiang pacification commission, and Puding Route subordinate tribes have linked with barbarian bandits, killing and plundering good people; admonition does not yield obedience; troops are being mobilized against Babao Xifu and military strength is depleted.
s0466.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Yunnan Lin'an, Dali, and other pacification commissions, Lijiang pacification commission, and Puding Route subordinate tribes have linked with barbarian bandits, killing and plundering good people; admonition does not yield obedience; troops are being mobilized against Babao Xifu and military strength is depleted.

s0467.literal: Now it is proposed — one horse to each Mongol soldier, two horses to each ten Han soldiers, paying fair value; we beg thirty thousand ingots of notes be granted.
s0467.idiomatic: Now it is proposed — one horse to each Mongol soldier, two horses to each ten Han soldiers, paying fair value; we beg 30,000 ingots of notes be granted.

s0468.literal: " They further said: "Sichuan Shaoxing Route's Rongmi Cave Timor has linked various barbarians, attacked Maliao and other stockades; troops are being mobilized for suppression; centurion Tashi was sent to admonish Timor Shishiyong and others to come and surrender.
s0468.idiomatic: They further said, "Sichuan Shaoxing Route's Rongmi Cave Timor has linked various barbarians, attacked Maliao and other stockades; troops are being mobilized for suppression; centurion Tashi was sent to admonish Timor Shishiyong and others to come and surrender.

s0469.literal: It is fitting to establish Huangsha Stockade, appointing Timor Shishiyong wanhu, Tashi darughachi of the Hedong-Shaanxi and other places wanhu thousand-household office, Liao Qilong judge of Laining Prefecture, Tian Siyuan judge of Huaide Prefecture; rewards granted and they sent back.
s0469.idiomatic: It is fitting to establish Huangsha Stockade, appointing Timor Shishiyong wanhu, Tashi darughachi of the Hedong-Shaanxi and other places wanhu thousand-household office, Liao Qilong judge of Laining Prefecture, Tian Siyuan judge of Huaide Prefecture; rewards granted and they sent back.

s0471.literal: Zhu Qing's son Hu and Zhang Xuan's son Wenlong were sent to manage sea transport; one confiscated residence and one hundred qing of fields were given them.
s0471.idiomatic: Zhu Qing's son Hu and Zhang Xuan's son Wenlong were sent to manage sea transport; one confiscated residence and 100 qing of fields were given them.

s0472.literal: Ministry of Revenue officials said: "Formerly Shizu appointed Prince Tughan Prince of Zhennan to reside at Yangzhou; now his son Lao Zhang, going in and out with escort guards, usurps imperial regalia.
s0472.idiomatic: Ministry of Revenue officials said, "Formerly Shizu appointed Prince Tughan Prince of Zhennan to reside at Yangzhou; now his son Lao Zhang, going in and out with escort guards, usurps imperial regalia.

s0473.literal: An edict orders officials sent to question him, and the usurped regalia brought up.
s0473.idiomatic: An edict orders officials sent to question him, and the usurped regalia brought up.

s0475.literal: Central Capital construction was ordered — ox carts to transport earth; each guard's warriors ordered to assist; deadline fifteenth day of fourth month next year; those missing the deadline — their chiefs punished; those voluntarily providing carts and oxen for transport separately rewarded.
s0475.idiomatic: Central Capital construction was ordered — ox carts to transport earth; each guard's warriors ordered to assist; deadline fifteenth day of fourth month next year; those missing the deadline — their chiefs punished; those voluntarily providing carts and oxen for transport separately rewarded.

s0476.literal: Jiang-Zhe left grand councillor Dashiman and Jiangxi left grand councillor Biebuqa came to court.
s0476.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe left grand councillor Dashiman and Jiangxi left grand councillor Biebuqa came to court.

s0477.literal: Shizu palace woman Boyalun was granted seven hundred fifty taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, and six hundred ingots of notes.
s0477.idiomatic: Shizu palace woman Boyalun was granted 750 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, and 600 ingots of notes.

s0478.literal: On bingshen day the Southern Suburb rites were performed; Taizu Emperor honored as paired recipient with August Heaven.
s0478.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Southern Suburb rites were performed; Taizu Emperor honored as paired recipient with August Heaven.

s0479.literal: On jihai day the Ministry of Revenue reported that Wu Guard personal army commander-in-chief Zheng A'ersilan with elder brother Zheng Rongzu, Duan Shuren, and others plotted rebellion; a case was opened for investigation; all falsely confessed; an edict ordered Shuren and seventeen others all executed by regular law, households registered and property confiscated.
s0479.idiomatic: On jihai day the Ministry of Revenue reported that Wu Guard personal army commander-in-chief Zheng A'ersilan with elder brother Zheng Rongzu, Duan Shuren, and others plotted rebellion; a case was opened for investigation; all falsely confessed; an edict ordered Shuren and 17 others all executed by regular law, households registered and property confiscated.

s0480.literal: Twelfth month, jiachen new moon: because the Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple was being built, Qishila was remotely appointed left vice director; Qulie and Liu Liang remotely appointed associate administrators, all overseeing Ministry of Works affairs.
s0480.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiachen new moon: because the Great Chong'en Fuyuan Temple was being built, Qishila was remotely appointed left vice director; Qulie and Liu Liang remotely appointed associate administrators, all overseeing Ministry of Works affairs.

s0481.literal: The Chonghui Bureau was established, subordinate to the Central Domestic Affairs Court.
s0481.idiomatic: The Chonghui Bureau was established, subordinate to the Central Domestic Affairs Court.

s0482.literal: On wushen day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.
s0482.idiomatic: On wushen day Jining Route suffered an earthquake.

s0483.literal: On jiwei day within and without were notified: those who evade corvée by registering under princes shall serve military relay.
s0483.idiomatic: On jiwei day within and without were notified: those who evade corvée by registering under princes shall serve military relay.

s0484.literal: Prince of Zhennan Lao Zhang presumptuously imitated guard regalia; investigation found proof; Lao Zhang was summoned to court.
s0484.idiomatic: Prince of Zhennan Lao Zhang presumptuously imitated guard regalia; investigation found proof; Lao Zhang was summoned to court.

s0485.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, guiyou new moon: the Emperor was unwell; audiences for congratulations were remitted; a great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.
s0485.idiomatic: Fourth year, spring, first month, guiyou new moon: the Emperor was unwell; audiences for congratulations were remitted; a great amnesty was granted throughout the realm.

s0486.literal: On gengchen day the Emperor died in the Yude Hall; he reigned five years; age thirty-one.
s0486.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Emperor died in the Yude Hall; he reigned five years; age thirty-one.

s0487.literal: On renwu day the imperial bier set out; he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.
s0487.idiomatic: On renwu day the imperial bier set out; he was buried at Qilian Valley, following the imperial tombs.

s0488.literal: Summer, fourth month, yiwei day: civil and military officials Yesian Temuer and others presented the posthumous title Renhui Xuanxiao Emperor; temple name Wuzong; in the national language Qulü Emperor.
s0488.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, yiwei day: civil and military officials Yesian Temuer and others presented the posthumous title Renhui Xuanxiao Emperor; temple name Wuzong; in the national language Qulü Emperor.

s0489.literal: That day posthumous rites were performed at the Southern Suburb.
s0489.idiomatic: That day posthumous rites were performed at the Southern Suburb.

s0490.literal: Intercalary seventh month, bingwu day: enshrined in the imperial ancestral temple.
s0490.idiomatic: Intercalary seventh month, bingwu day: enshrined in the imperial ancestral temple.

s0491.literal: Wuzong faced a great inheritance of wealth; resolute in wishing to create new governance, reform laws, and act with purpose — therefore his enfeoffments were excessive, remote appointments numerous, bestowals overly lavish, and indiscriminate grace too widely extended; the policies of Zhiyuan and Dade were from this point slightly changed.
s0491.idiomatic: Wuzong faced a great inheritance of wealth; resolute in wishing to create new governance, reform laws, and act with purpose — therefore his enfeoffments were excessive, remote appointments numerous, bestowals overly lavish, and indiscriminate grace too widely extended; the policies of Zhiyuan and Dade were from this point slightly changed.
